functions.purpose: Initializes the pet-hit anti-cheat frequency-queue depth from config key 'PetHitFreqQueue'; if the config lookup fails the default is 3. Passes result to FUN_11060d00 (reserves/sizes the hit-record ring buffer).
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative/validation: this is server-side pet-hit rate-limit config init. Reproduce default PetHitFreqQueue=3 when the config value is absent.
formulas: queueDepth = config('PetHitFreqQueue'); if lookup fails => queueDepth = 3; then FUN_11060d00(queueDepth)
functions.notes: Config read via FUN_100b62c0/FUN_11479100/FUN_1147cea0 (data-table lookup returning success char).

functions.purpose: SERVER-SIDE authoritative validation of a single pet melee hit report. Resolves attacker entity (attackInfo+0x124) and target entity (attackInfo+0x128), verifies both have physics proxies and that the reported physical entity matches the attacker; verifies bone/joint id (vtbl+0x88) consistency; performs a 3D position-deviation check between the claimed hit positions (param_5/param_6) and the real entity positions; then applies hit-range and hit-frequency/hit-count rate limits before recording the hit in a ring buffer. Returns an error code (1..6) via FUN_114811e0 on any failure, or records the hit and returns success.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative/validation: MUST be re-implemented server-side. Rejects spoofed/too-frequent/too-distant pet hits. Error codes propagated to caller.
formulas: err1: attacker/target entity missing, proxy null, physics-entity(0x800) null, or reported phys-entity != attacker phys-entity
err2: attacker bone id (vtbl+0x88) != target bone id when both != -1 (bone/joint mismatch)

position check: dev = (float)config('PositionDeviation'); reject(err3) if sqrt(dx^2+dy^2+dz^2) > dev for attacker(pos param_5) OR target(pos param_6); check skipped if either entity's flag (vtbl+0x68) != 0
range check (only if attackInfo+0xc == 0): reject(err4) unless (attackInfo+0x160,+0x164) equals current range (this+0x38,+0x3c) OR previous range (this+0x30,+0x34)
hit-count: piCount=(int*)(this+0x40); *piCount -= 1; reject(err5) if *piCount < 0 (only when attackInfo+0xc==0)
queueCount = (this+0x24 - this+0x20)/0x18 (ring buffer entry stride = 0x18 = 24 bytes = 6 dwords)
freqQueueMin = config('PetHitFreqQueue'); clamped to >= 1

if freqQueueMin <= queueCount (buffer full enough): find oldest entry (min by dword[1]=ts_hi then dword[0]=ts_lo); delta64 = (param_3:param_2) - (oldest[1]:oldest[0]); if delta>0: freq = __alldiv(queueCount*1000, delta64); reject(err6) if config('PetHitFreqMax') <= freq
on accept: overwrite oldest entry with { [0]=param_2(ts_lo), [1]=param_3(ts_hi), [2]=attackInfo+0x160, [3]=attackInfo+0x164, [4]=attackInfo+0x128(targetId) }
if buffer not yet full (freqQueueMin > queueCount): append new entry via FUN_11060c90({ts_lo,ts_hi,+0x160,(targetId:+0x164)})
costs: PetHitFreqMax = max allowed hit frequency; freq metric = queueCount*1000 / deltaTimeMs. Higher freq (hits arriving faster) rejected when freq >= PetHitFreqMax.
PositionDeviation = max allowed distance (world units, float) between claimed and actual hit position
PetHitFreqQueue = minimum ring-buffer fill before frequency gating engages
functions.notes: param_2/param_3 form a 64-bit hit timestamp (lo/hi, ms). this+0x20/0x24 = ring-buffer begin/end; this+0x30/0x34 current hit-range, +0x38/0x3c previous hit-range, +0x40 remaining-hit-count. this+0x44 -> +0x2cd8 = scene/entity-system pointer used to resolve entity ids (call +0x4c). Companion setters: InitFreqQueueDepth(0x1105fe90), SetHitRangeAndCount(0x11060380).

functions.purpose: Configures the expected hit window for the next pet attack: rotates the current hit-range (this+0x30/0x34) into the previous slot (this+0x38/0x3c) if valid, stores the new range (param_2 lo, param_3 hi) into this+0x30/0x34, and loads the max hit count from config 'PetHitCountMax' into this+0x40 (default 0 if lookup fails). Returns early (no-op) when the new range encodes an empty/negative window.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative/validation: sets the range/count budget consumed by ValidatePetHit. Reproduce server-side.
formulas: guard: if (param_3 < 1) && (param_3 < 0 || param_2 == 0) => return 0 (invalid/empty window)
if current range valid ((this+0x34>0) || (this+0x34==0 && this+0x30!=0)): this+0x38=this+0x30; this+0x3c=this+0x34; this+0x30=0; this+0x34=0
this+0x30=param_2; this+0x34=param_3 (new 64-bit hit-range key)
this+0x40 = config('PetHitCountMax'); if lookup fails => this+0x40 = 0
returns 1
costs: PetHitCountMax = max number of hits allowed for the attack window
functions.notes: param_2/param_3 = 64-bit range key (matches attackInfo+0x160/+0x164 compared in ValidatePetHit).

functions.purpose: Fired when a soul-beast's level crosses a threshold (param_1+8 = oldLevel, param_1+0xc = newLevel, param_1+4 = soulBeastId). Grants activity reward 0x15f0 unconditionally; looks up the CSoulBeastInfo row, then scans two per-row threshold lists: if any entry in list at row+0x2c/+0x3c has (+0x34) in (old,new] grants 0x15f5; if any entry in list at row+0x2c/+0x28 has (+0x50) in (old,new] grants 0x15f9. Sends message 0x2c0 {mode=7, soulBeastId, 0} to the client and posts a 'PlayChange' UI event (id 0x953).
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: server grants soul-beast level-milestone rewards and notifies the client. Reward ids 0x15f0/0x15f5/0x15f9, message 0x2c0.
formulas: CInfoManager sparse-id lookup on CSoulBeastInfo (idx = id - mgr+0x30; bucket math via mgr+0x20/+0x28)
milestone A: for entry in [row+0x2c +0x3c .. +0x40): if old(+8) < entry[+0x34] <= new(+0xc) => GrantActivityReward(0x15f5); break
milestone B: for entry in [row+0x2c +0x28 .. +0x2c): if old(+8) < entry[+0x50] <= new(+0xc) => GrantActivityReward(0x15f9); break
client msg 0x2c0 payload {0x90=7, soulBeastId, 0}
functions.notes: row+0x2c is the soul-beast detail sub-struct holding the two upgrade lists.

Marks the beast activated via FUN_114149b0(id,0) and sends client message 0x2c0 {mode=2, id, 0}.

formulas: prompt = FUN_1112f070(0x15f7, formatted_name)
client msg 0x2c0 payload {0x90=2, soulBeastId, 0}

functions.purpose: Validation predicate for summoning a pet (id param_2). Returns 0 (OK) or an error code. Checks: pet row exists; party-leader gate (member+0xc vtbl+0x164); a capability flag (self vtbl+0x78); player hunt rank >= pet required rank (row+0x14); and the summoned-pet count limit.

if self capability vtbl+0x78 == 0 => return 0x759c
if CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount() < row+0x14 (required rank) => return 0x759f
curCount = *(this[3]+0x34); maxCount = FUN_1158d1e0(); if curCount <= maxCount => return 0x75a0 (limit reached) else 0
if pet row missing => return 0x7596
costs: error codes: 0x7596 invalid pet, 0x759b not-leader, 0x759c no-capability, 0x759f rank-too-low, 0x75a0 pet-limit-reached
row+0x14 = required hunt rank to summon this pet

functions.purpose: Validation predicate for a pet 'fire'/deployment action (soul-beast/pet ranged dispatch). Returns 0 (OK) or an error code. if not party leader => return 0x759b

for slot in 0..5: if FUN_114242c0(slot) != 0 => return 0x75a3 (slot conflict)
if CPetFireInfo row for fireId (FUN_11567170) missing => return 0x7599; else return 0
costs: error codes: 0x7597 no-active-pet, 0x759b not-leader, 0x759c no-capability, 0x75a1 pet-busy, 0x75a3 slot-conflict, 0x7599 invalid-fire-config
